newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks end sharply higher.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks end sharply higher.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks ended sharply higher on Wednesday, lifted by a firm bond market and strong buying of high-technology shares.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average rose 71.77 points to close at 8,259.31.
In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a margin of 2-1 on heavy volume of about 566 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
The Nasdaq Composite index, laden with technology shares, rose 8.89 to 1,630.42.
